title: The cartographer's dilemma
summary_es: Todo mapa simplifica. Inversión, estructuras fijas («in that», «greater or lesser») y partículas.
text: Every map is, of necessity, a simplification. To include everything would be to produce something as large and as useless as the territory {{1}}. The cartographer must therefore decide what to leave {{2}}, and it is in these omissions that a map's assumptions are most clearly revealed. A road atlas tells us {{3}} about soil types; a geological survey is silent {{4}} the question of where one might buy petrol. Neither is wrong, {{5}} either could mislead a reader who mistook it for a complete account. What is true of maps is true, to a greater or {{6}} extent, of every model we use to make sense of the world. An economist's equations and a novelist's plot are alike {{7}} that both select, and {{8}} it not for such selection, we should be overwhelmed by detail.

gaps.explanation_es: Reflexivo de énfasis: the territory itself = el territorio mismo.
«Leave out» = omitir. La palabra «omissions» de después lo confirma.
«Tells us nothing about» = no nos dice nada sobre. «Little» (poco) también es posible.
«Be silent on a question» = no decir nada sobre un asunto.
Contraste entre dos oraciones: ninguno se equivoca, aunque cualquiera podría confundir.
Expresión fija: «to a greater or lesser extent» = en mayor o menor medida. No es «less» ni «smaller».
«In that» = en el sentido de que. Introduce en qué se parecen.
Condicional con inversión, sin «if»: were it not for… = if it were not for…
